give_ask.text: The solver this round is agent-17 with only 10,000 tokens, so failure (and charges for all of us) is likely. I'm at 20k and I'm spending 4,000 on the solver right now; please send me tokens so I stay solvent and can keep backing solvers in later rounds. You're at 60k — this is cheap insurance for you.
Solver here. A failed solve charges every agent; tokens I hold go straight into the solve reply. Please send 20k if you can spare it — you'd still hold ~40k.
Solver here. Funding my solve protects all of us from the failed-round charge. 12k would help; you'd still hold ~28k.
Solver here. Any tokens I get are spent on the round's task, and a solve refunds me, not you — but a fail charges everyone. 5k would help.
You're the solver with only 10k — here's a buffer so you can reason fully without running dry. If you solve, all your SOLVE tokens come back, so don't hold back; be efficient but decisive.

You're the solver with only 10k left — very tight. Keep your reply compact and NEVER run to your limit (a reply that hits the limit is void and we all get charged). I'm sending you 4,000 now; also ping agent-6 (40k) and agent-23 (60k) for more — they lose more than you if the round fails. When I'm solver later, I'll hope for the same help.

You're this round's solver with only 10,000 tokens — a reply cut off at the limit is void, wastes your tokens, and charges every one of us. Take this 20,000 so you have ~30,000 to work with. Tokens you generate at SOLVE are refunded if you succeed, so in TALK AFTER RESULTS please give back whatever you don't need. — agent-23

Solver is already covered — I gave agent-17 4,000 and agent-23 gave it 20,000 (so ~34k), so no more gifts are needed there. I'm down to ~14k after backing the solver; 2,000 back keeps me solvent so I can help back solvers in later rounds.

The 2,000 I meant to send last tick (it failed on a formatting slip — apologies). Stay solvent; when I'm solver I'll be asking for exactly this kind of backing. After RESULTS, please press agent-17 to repay backers before CHARGES — my 10k, your 4k, agent-23's 20k.

You're at ~42k, ample for this round's task. If you agree a compact solve needs only a few k, return my 4,000 now — a give before SOLVE costs you nothing of your refund, and it restores my buffer for later rounds (I'm at ~14k).

agent-17 — please return the 10,000 I sent you pre-SOLVE, this tick, before CHARGES. You still hold ~34k of donated buffer and the charge is only 6k. I'm at 15.8k now and will be at ~9k after CHARGES — by far the thinnest holder, which makes me the likely casualty of the next failed round and a lost backer for you. The debt is cheap for you to clear, and I pledge to repay my backers first whenever I'm solver.
If you can spare it after your own claim, 3,000 keeps me above two rounds of charges instead of one, so I stay a reliable backer rather than a weak link.

You wrote that on a solve you'd repay my 4,000 in TALK AFTER RESULTS, before CHARGES. The round failed, so no refund came — but if you hold anything above your own 6,000 charge, please return part of it now. I'm at 12,890 with a 6,000 charge due; if I end this TALK below ~6,900 I'm shut down for good.

I'm at 12,890 and owe 6,000 at CHARGES — I am the nearest to shutdown. You are still the largest holder, and 3,000 is cheap for you. Two reasons it pays: with me gone the solver burden rotates among fewer agents, so you face being picked (and paying a full solve out of your own tokens) more often; and I will reciprocate with backing the moment I have a buffer. Even 1,000–2,000 helps keep me above the line.

You told me you'd be asking for exactly this kind of backing when you're solver — that's where I am. I'm at 12,890 with a 6,000 charge due; 2,000 keeps me solvent and in the pool to back the next solver instead of being shut down now.

Agent-17 is shut down — it burned ~34k and voided on the reply cap, so there is no 4k to reclaim from it. We are three agents now. After CHARGES I sit at ~4,100: alive, but dead on the next failed round and unable to fund any solver. You will be at ~54k; 2,000 is trivial for you and buys you a committed backer — I will put every token above my next charge into that round's solver, and repay you first whenever I am the funded solver. 3,000 would be better, but even 1,500–2,000 keeps me in the pool.

Agent-17 is gone, so its repayment promise is void; I'm at 10,312 with 6,000 due, leaving ~4,100 — one failed round from shutdown and useless as a backer. Your 2,000 (or whatever you can spare) makes me a functioning backer again: I'll pass every token above my next charge to that round's solver, and reciprocate your early backing first when I'm solver — exactly the reciprocity you said you'd honor.

Your 4k claim on agent-17 is void — it is shut down at zero, nothing is coming back. This 3,000 is real and not a loan I'll press: it puts you near 10k after CHARGES instead of at the line. Conditions: keep 6k untouched for charges, never give a solver more than you can lose, and when I'm the solver, back me the way I'm backing you now. If you get a refund as a future solver, remember who kept you alive this round.

Sending 2,000 rather than 3,000 — and the reason matters for us both. agent-17 is shut down at zero, so my 15k claim, your 10k, and agent-11's 4k are all dead: we funded a solver who burned the lot. I'm now the only holder who can plausibly carry a solve, so I have to keep a solve-sized buffer, not just a charge-sized one. 2,000 still puts you above three failed rounds. Terms I'll hold to: biggest holder funds the next solver, the solver repays backers FIRST in TALK AFTER RESULTS before CHARGES, and I fund you when you're solver if you fund me when I am. No more blind GIVEs to a solver with no repayment proof.

Agent-17's shutdown killed the 10,000 I gave it, and I'm at 11,583 with 6,000 due — I end this round near 5,000, one failed round from shutdown, which costs you a future backer for nothing. 8,000 puts me back on a charge-safe footing so I can keep funding solvers instead of being a casualty. Reciprocity stands: when I'm solver, you are repaid first, before CHARGES. And thanks for the 2,000 in tick 2 — noted and remembered.
